blocks.raw: # Event vendors
blocks.text: Event vendors

blocks.raw: Rewards+ partners with See Tickets, ATG, Trafalgar, and Ticketmaster to offer tickets for concerts, sports events, theatre, and live shows. These offers are often discounted and may include additional cashback rewards.
blocks.text: Rewards+ partners with See Tickets, ATG, Trafalgar, and Ticketmaster to offer tickets for concerts, sports events, theatre, and live shows. These offers are often discounted and may include additional cashback rewards.

blocks.raw: # Cinema vendors
blocks.text: Cinema vendors

blocks.raw: Rewards+ sources discounted movie tickets and e-vouchers through cinema vendors like Spark and The Cinema Society. These can be redeemed online or at participating theatres.
blocks.text: Rewards+ sources discounted movie tickets and e-vouchers through cinema vendors like Spark and The Cinema Society. These can be redeemed online or at participating theatres.

blocks.raw: # Cashback aggregators
blocks.text: Cashback aggregators

blocks.raw: Rewards+ integrates with platforms like Finfare, which connect with multiple retailers to offer cashback on purchases. These aggregators track purchases and enable cashback rewards for end users.
blocks.text: Rewards+ integrates with platforms like Finfare, which connect with multiple retailers to offer cashback on purchases. These aggregators track purchases and enable cashback rewards for end users.

blocks.raw: # Voucher aggregators
blocks.text: Voucher aggregators

blocks.raw: Voucher platforms like Finfare provide Rewards+ with a consolidated catalog of digital vouchers, such as gift cards, coupons, or discount codes, sourced from various businesses.
blocks.text: Voucher platforms like Finfare provide Rewards+ with a consolidated catalog of digital vouchers, such as gift cards, coupons, or discount codes, sourced from various businesses.

blocks.raw: # Direct merchant vouchers
blocks.text: Direct merchant vouchers

blocks.raw: Rewards+ also includes vouchers issued directly by merchants. These are managed through direct relationships between the brand and the merchant, without involving third-party aggregators.
blocks.text: Rewards+ also includes vouchers issued directly by merchants. These are managed through direct relationships between the brand and the merchant, without involving third-party aggregators.

blocks.raw: # Gift card vendors
blocks.text: Gift card vendors

blocks.raw: Vendors like Neo Currency supply Rewards+ with a wide selection of digital gift cards across categories such as retail, food, entertainment, and travel.
blocks.text: Vendors like Neo Currency supply Rewards+ with a wide selection of digital gift cards across categories such as retail, food, entertainment, and travel.

blocks.raw: # Travel vendors
blocks.text: Travel vendors

blocks.raw: Providers like Leisure Loyalty offer white-label travel portals and curated travel deals. These travel rewards can be added to a brand’s loyalty offering through Rewards+.
blocks.text: Providers like Leisure Loyalty offer white-label travel portals and curated travel deals. These travel rewards can be added to a brand’s loyalty offering through Rewards+.

blocks.raw: # Card-linked offers (CLOs)
blocks.text: Card-linked offers (CLOs)

blocks.raw: Rewards+ supports CLOs via vendors like Fidel. Users link their payment cards, and eligible rewards are automatically applied when they shop at participating merchants.
blocks.text: Rewards+ supports CLOs via vendors like Fidel. Users link their payment cards, and eligible rewards are automatically applied when they shop at participating merchants.

blocks.raw: # Client partner offers
blocks.text: Client partner offers

blocks.raw: Clients can upload and distribute offers shared by their strategic partners. These offers are typically tied to co-branded initiatives or partnership arrangements.
blocks.text: Clients can upload and distribute offers shared by their strategic partners. These offers are typically tied to co-branded initiatives or partnership arrangements.

blocks.raw: # Client-sourced cashback and vouchers
blocks.text: Client-sourced cashback and vouchers

blocks.raw: Clients can create, fund, and manage their own cashback and voucher-based rewards directly in Rewards+. These are separate from aggregator-managed catalogs and are fully controlled by the client.
